class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Objective</h2>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">This document provides instructions on configuring API Discovery on the F5® Distributed Cloud Services platform. This core capability is essential for dynamically identifying and monitoring your application's API endpoints.</p>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">This guide is specific to the API Discovery feature. For instructions about API Protection configuration, see <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-protection">Setting Up API Protection</a>.</p>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="prerequisites"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-security#prerequisites"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Prerequisites</h2>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">A valid <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="https://console.ves.volterra.io/">F5 Distributed Cloud Console</a> SaaS account. If you do not have an account, see <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="/docs-v2/platform/quickstart/get-started-on-console">Getting Started with Console</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">An active HTTP Load Balancer configured for your application within the Distributed Cloud environment. See <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="/docs-v2/platform/quickstart/web-app-security-performance">Deploy a Secure Application and Monitor Performance</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">For code discovery: Source code management API key.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">For API crawling: Standard user and password.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="set-up-api-discovery"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-security#set-up-api-discovery"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Set Up API Discovery</h3>
<details><summary><b>Step 1:</b> Find your HTTP Load Balancer.</summary><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Log into Console.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Web App & API Protection</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select your namespace.</p>
</li>
</ul><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-60455j"><img alt="Figure: Select Namespace" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/20--api-security/images/select-namespace.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fselect-namespace.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Select Namespace</p></div><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Manage</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Load Balancers</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">HTTP Load Balancers</code> and locate your HTTP load balancer in the list.</li>
</ul><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-1nig5rn"><img alt="Figure: Load Balancers" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/20--api-security/images/load-balancers-page.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fload-balancers-page.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Load Balancers</p></div></details>
<details><summary><b>Step 2:</b> Enable API Discovery. </summary><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-1nig5rn"><img alt="Figure: Manage Load Balancer Configuration" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/20--api-security/images/manage-lb-config.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmanage-lb-config.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Manage Load Balancer Configuration</p></div><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">For the target load balancer, click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">...</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Manage Configuration</code> in the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Action</code> column.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Edit Configuration</code> in the top-right section of the page.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Scroll down to the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Protection</code> section.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Enable</code> from the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Discovery</code> drop-down menu.  This will also expose the API discovery settings.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select your desired option from the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Learn From Traffic With Direct Response</code> drop-down menu. By default, API Discovery learns only from traffic with 2xx (successful) responses. You can choose to select <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Enable Learning From Redirect Traffic</code> to also learn from traffic with 3xx (redirect) responses.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Use the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Purge Duration for Inactive Discovered APIs</code> field to specify how often to delete inactive discovered APIs. The purging occurs after the number of days you specify expires.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Scroll to the bottom of the page and click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Save and Exit</code>.</p>
</li>
</ul></details>
<details><summary><b>Step 3:</b> Add Code Scanning API Discovery. </summary><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-8qmzx4"><img alt="Figure: Add Code Base Integration" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/20--api-security/images/add-code-base.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fadd-code-base.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Add Code Base Integration</p></div><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Navigate to <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Manage</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Management</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Code Base Integration</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Add Code Base Integration</code>.</p>
</li>
</ul><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-1s4jica"><img alt="Figure: Add Code Base Integration Form" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/20--api-security/images/code-base-form.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fcode-base-form.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Add Code Base Integration Form</p></div><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Enter a name for this integration and optionally enter labels and a description.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select the code base you want to integrate (GitHub, GitLab, azure, and so on) from the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Code Base</code> drop-down menu.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Based on your selected code base, you will need to add the required integration information (in other words, API key/username with password) to the Console. You can obtain integration information for your codebase as described in one of the options shown below.</p>
</li>
</ul><details><summary><b>Azure Repository Integration</b></summary><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In Azure DevOps:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Create a personal access token in Azure DevOps (under <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">User Settings</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Personal Access tokens</code>).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">New Token</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Set a label <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">F5 integration</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Scopes: Ensure <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Custom defined</code> is selected and select the following options:</p>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Code: <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Read</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">User Profile: <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Read</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Create</code>. Then, copy your newly-created personal access token into the paste buffer.</p>
</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><b>GitHub or GitHub Enterprise Integration</b></summary><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In GitHub:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Generate a new token (classic or fine-grained) in GitHub (<code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Settings</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Developer Settings</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Personal Access tokens</code>).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Set a note <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">F5 integration</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Set an expiration date.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Configure the scopes as follows:</p>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Classic token</p>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Read_api</li>
<li>User > read:user</li>
<li>User > user:email</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Fine-grained</p>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Repository permission > Contents:read-only</li>
<li>Repository permissions > Metadata:read-only</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Generate Token</code>. Then, copy your newly-created token into the paste buffer.</p>
</li>
</ul><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In Distributed Cloud Console, perform one of the following:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">GitHub Integration: Enter your GitHub username into the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">GitHub Username</code> field.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">GitHub Enterprise Integration: Fill in the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">GitHub Hostname</code> and <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">GitHub Username</code> fields.</p>
</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><b>GitLab Cloud or GitLab Enterprise Integration</b></summary><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In GitLab:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Create an access token (under <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Preferences</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Access Tokens</code>).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Set a label <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">F5 integration</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Set expiration date.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Configure the scope as follows:</p>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Read_api</li>
<li>Read_repository</li>
<li>Read_user</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Create Personal access token</code>. Then, copy your newly-created token into the paste buffer.</p><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In Distributed Cloud Console, if you selected <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">GitLab Enterprise Integration</code>, enter your GitLab URL in the <strong class="mui-style-0">GitLab URL</strong> field.</p></details><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In Distributed Cloud Console:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Configure</code> to bring up the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Secret Type</code> form.  You can either Blindfold your token/password or you can store it in the clear.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Paste your token/password into either the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Secret to Blindfold</code> or <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Secret</code> field.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Apply</code> to save your token.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Save and Exit</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Go back to your load balancer (from Step 1) and scroll down to the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Protection</code> section.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Make sure API discovery is enabled and click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Configure</code> under <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Repositories</code>. This will bring up an empty list of code base integrations. Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Add Item</code> to start the list.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select the code base you created above.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select the API repositories you wish to include from the code base.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Scroll to the bottom and click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Save and Exit</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">You can now see in the API inventory the source of detection of API endpoints. Note that it can take up to two hours for the discovery process to run and show results.</p>
</li>
</ul><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-hzmnxe"><img alt="Figure: Monitor API Endpoints" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/20--api-security/images/monitor-endpoints.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F20--api-security%2Fimages%2Fmonitor-endpoints.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Monitor API Endpoints</p></div></details>

mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Manage Load Balancer Configuration</p></div><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">For the target load balancer, click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">...</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Manage Configuration</code> in the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Action</code> column.</p>

<li>

</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Scroll down to the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Protection</code> section.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Enable</code> from the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Crawling</code> drop-down menu (<code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Discovery</code> must be enabled to see the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Crawling</code> drop-down menu). This will also expose the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Domains to Crawl</code> list.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">For each domain you want to crawl,</p>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Add Item</code> in the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Domains to Crawl</code> list.</li>
<li>Enter the domain you want to crawl. Optionally, you can click in the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Domain</code> field and then click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">See Suggestions</code>.</li>
<li>Enter the username in the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">User</code> field.</li>
<li>To enter the password, click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Configure</code> to bring up the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Secret Type</code> form. You can either Blindfold your password or you can store it in the clear.<!-- -->
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Paste your token/password into either the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Secret to Blindfold</code> or <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Secret</code> field.</li>
<li>Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Apply</code> to save your secret (password).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Apply</code> to save your domain to the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Domains to Crawl</code> list.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Scroll to the bottom of the page and click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Save and Exit</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>

<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="code-discovery"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-security#code-discovery"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Code Discovery</h3>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Supported languages and frameworks:</li>
</ul>
<table class="mui-style-i6cxyj"><thead><tr><th>Language</th><th>Frameworks</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Java</td><td>EE, Spring</td></tr><tr><td>.Net</td><td>Versions 7.0, 6.0, 5.0, 3.1</td></tr><tr><td>Python</td><td>Flask, Django (function-based views)</td></tr><tr><td>JavaScript</td><td>Express, Hapi</td></tr><tr><td>Go</td><td>Gin</td></tr></tbody></table>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Compatible SCM platforms:<!-- -->
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Azure Repositories</li>
<li>GitHub (Standard and Enterprise)</li>
<li>GitLab (Standard and Enterprise)</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote class="mui-style-qi28wy">
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr"><strong class="mui-style-0">Important:</strong> The repository scans operate at the organization level, not from the user level.</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="api-crawling-key-information"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-security#api-crawling-key-information"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>API Crawling Key Information</h3>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">No multi-factor authentication (MFA) support.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Credentials are mandatory.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">API Crawling is performed on the application client-side (not the server-side).</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="troubleshooting-information"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-security#troubleshooting-information"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Troubleshooting Information</h3>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Scan time expectations:</li>
</ul>
<table class="mui-style-i6cxyj"><thead><tr><th>Discovery Method</th><th>Expected Time</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>API Crawling</td><td>Up to 4 hours</td></tr><tr><td>New repositories</td><td>Once daily</td></tr><tr><td>Existing repositories</td><td>Once Daily</td></tr><tr><td>Token validity</td><td>Every 5 minutes</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="common-issues"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-security#common-issues"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Common Issues</h3>
<details><summary><b>No Results After Expected Time</b></summary><ol class="mui-style-1u4wrn3">
<li>Check credentials:</li>
</ol><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Correct username and password</li>
<li>No MFA requirements</li>
<li>Not expired</li>
<li>Proper permissions</li>
</ul><ol start="2" class="mui-style-1u4wrn3">
<li>For API Crawling:</li>
</ol><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Using root domain</li>
<li>Website accessible via the browser</li>
<li>No geo-restrictions</li>
<li>No WAF or bot protections blocking</li>
</ul></details>

<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">This document provides instructions on configuring API Protection on the F5® Distributed Cloud Platform. This core capability is essential for dynamically securing and monitoring your application's API endpoints.</p>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="prerequisites"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-protection#prerequisites"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Prerequisites</h2>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="https://console.ves.volterra.io/">An F5 Distributed Cloud Console</a> SaaS account. If you do not have an account, see <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="/docs-v2/platform/quickstart/get-started-on-console">Get Started with Console</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Active HTTP Load Balancer configured for your application within the Distributed Cloud environment. See <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="/docs-v2/platform/quickstart/web-app-security-performance#step-2-load-balancer">Setting up a load balancer on WAAP</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">OpenAPI Specification files, if applicable.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">API Discovery is set up.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="concepts"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-protection#concepts"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Concepts</h2>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">OpenAPI Specification</strong>: A standard format used to define and describe RESTful APIs. By uploading OpenAPI specs, you can define the structure of your APIs and ensure that API Discovery is aware of all intended endpoints.</li>
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">Schema Validation</strong>: Ensures that API traffic conforms to a specified schema. This is crucial for preventing security vulnerabilities, especially those highlighted in the OWASP API Security Top 10. Schema validation can block or report non-compliant traffic.</li>
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">API Protection</strong>: Encompasses a set of features, including schema validation, service policies, and threat protection, designed to secure your API endpoints from attacks and unauthorized access.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="configuration"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-protection#configuration"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Configuration</h2>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">The configuration process is divided into two sections: API Discovery and API Protection.</p>
<table class="mui-style-i6cxyj"><thead><tr><th>Activity</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Find HTTP Load Balancer</td><td>Locate the specific HTTP Load Balancer where API Discovery will be enabled.</td></tr><tr><td>Upload OpenAPI Specs and Apply API Definitions</td><td>Upload OpenAPI Specification files, create API definitions, and apply them to the load balancer.</td></tr><tr><td>Configure API Protection (Schema Validation)</td><td>Set up schema validation as part of API Protection.</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="set-up-api-discovery"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-protection#set-up-api-discovery"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Set Up API Discovery</h3>
<details><summary><b>Step 1:</b> Prepare OpenAPI Specification Files.</summary><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Prepare your OpenAPI specification files locally with the required API definitions.</p></details>
<details><summary><b>Step 2:</b> Upload OpenAPI Specification Files and Apply API Definitions.</summary><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Log into Console.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Web App & API Protection</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select your namespace.</p>
</li>

<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="set-up-api-protection"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/api-protection#set-up-api-protection"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Set Up API Protection</h3>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Validation is disabled by default. Follow these steps to enable and configure it.</p>
<details><summary><b>Step 1:</b> Enable OpenAPI Validation.</summary><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Manage</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Load Balancers</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">HTTP Load Balancers</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Actions</code> column for your load balancer, select <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">...</code> > <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Manage Configuration</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Edit Configuration</code> in the upper right corner.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Scroll down to the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Protection</code> section.</p>
</li>
</ul><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-pub8i6"><img alt="Figure: API Definition Validation Choices" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/21--api-protection/images/api-def-validation-choices.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F21--api-protection%2Fimages%2Fapi-def-validation-choices.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: API Definition Validation Choices</p></div><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Choose a validation method.</li>
</ul></details>
<details><summary><b>Step 2:</b> API Inventory Validation</summary><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Select <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">API Inventory</code> in the <code class="mui-style-3j2nil">Validation</code> drop-down menu.</p>
</li>
<li>

      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - strong: Schema Validation
        - text: ": Ensures that API traffic conforms to a specified schema. This is crucial for preventing security vulnerabilities, especially those highlighted in the OWASP API Security Top 10. Schema validation can block or report non-compliant traffic."

        - strong: API Protection
        - text: ": Encompasses a set of features, including schema validation, service policies, and threat protection, designed to secure your API endpoints from attacks and unauthorized access."

<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">This guide provides instructions on how to set up and configure API testing for detecting vulnerabilities in your APIs before they reach production. This guide covers credential management, environment configuration, and viewing test results within the F5® Distributed Cloud Services platform.</p>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="prerequisites"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/automate-sec-test#prerequisites"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Prerequisites</h2>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">A valid <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="https://console.ves.volterra.io/">F5 Distributed Cloud Account</a>. If you do not have an account, see <a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" href="/docs-v2/platform/quickstart/get-started-on-console">Getting Started with Console</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">One or more applications deployed with configured services</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">An active HTTP load balancer configured for your application.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">API endpoints that need to be tested.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Valid credentials for testing.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote class="mui-style-qi28wy">
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr"><strong class="mui-style-0">Note:</strong> Supported authentication types include API key, basic authentication, JWT bearer token, and login endpoint.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="procedure"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/automate-sec-test#procedure"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Procedure</h2>
<details><summary><b>Step 1:</b> Enable API testing.</summary><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">In the <strong class="mui-style-0">Multi-Cloud App Connect</strong> service, navigate to your load balancer configuration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Click <strong class="mui-style-0">...</strong> > <strong class="mui-style-0">Manage Configuration</strong> > <strong class="mui-style-0">Edit Configuration</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Navigate to the <strong class="mui-style-0">API Protection</strong> section.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">From the <strong class="mui-style-0">API Testing</strong> drop-down menu, select <strong class="mui-style-0">Enabled</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ul><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-7bah7v"><div class="MuiGrid-root MuiGrid-container mui-style-3f6cdh"><img alt="Figure: Enable Testing" data-src="/docs-v2/images/04--quickstart/23--automate-api-sec-testing/images/enable-api-testing-menu.png" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;object-fit:contain;color:transparent" sizes="100vw" srcset="/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=640&q=75 640w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=750&q=75 750w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=828&q=75 828w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=1080&q=75 1080w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=1200&q=75 1200w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=1920&q=75 1920w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=2048&q=75 2048w, /docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=3840&q=75 3840w" src="https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-v2%2Fimages%2F04--quickstart%2F23--automate-api-sec-testing%2Fimages%2Fenable-api-testing-menu.png&w=3840&q=75"><div class="MuiGrid-root mui-style-1b65zy1"></div></div><p class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body2 mui-style-er6c0y">Figure: Enable Testing</p></div></details>

<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="testing-limitations"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/automate-sec-test#testing-limitations"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Testing Limitations</h2>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Advanced authentication mechanisms (OAuth) are not included</li>
<li>Users cannot select specific tests to run</li>
<li>A minimum of 3 credential sets is required for testing (2 users and 1 admin) to test complex authorization scenarios.</li>
<li>Only domains from the load balancer can be added for testing</li>
<li>Authentication support is limited to:<!-- -->
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>API Key authentication</li>
<li>Basic authentication</li>
<li>JWT Bearer Token</li>
<li>Login Endpoint</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Credentials of types: API Key, Basic, JWT; must not expire within the testing period</li>
</ul>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="feature-concepts"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/automate-sec-test#feature-concepts"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Feature Concepts</h2>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">Testing Environment</strong>: Configuration of domains and credentials where API tests will be executed.</li>
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">Credentials Management</strong>: System for managing authentication details used during API testing. All credentials are saved as secrets with the option for users to blindfold them.</li>
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">Custom Headers</strong>: Special HTTP headers that identify API testing traffic.</li>
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">Testing Schedule</strong>: Automated testing cycle that can be set to daily, weekly, or monthly frequencies.</li>
<li><strong class="mui-style-0">Vulnerability Source</strong>: Indicates how a vulnerability was detected (API Testing or Traffic Analysis).</li>
</ul>
<hr class="mui-style-1fkg4y7">
<h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-style-1p1yoqh" id="troubleshooting"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/automate-sec-test#troubleshooting"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>Troubleshooting</h2>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Below are some common issues and proposed solutions.</p>
<details><summary><b>Last Tested Column Shows N/A for All Endpoints</b></summary><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Issue: This indicates that no tests have been initiated.</p><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Resolution:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Validate that all credentials are correctly configured.</li>
<li>Delete any existing credentials.</li>
<li>Add credentials again.</li>
<li>Save the configuration.</li>
<li>Wait up to one (1) hour for tests to initiate.</li>
<li>If tests are still not showing after 1 hour, open a support ticket.</li>
</ul></details>
<details><summary><b>Tests Not Running on Schedule</b></summary><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Issue: Weekly tests not executing as expected.</p><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Resolution:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Verify that credentials have not expired.</li>
<li>Ensure testing environment is properly configured.</li>
<li>Check if the domain is still valid and accessible.</li>
</ul></details>
<details><summary><b>Authentication Failures</b></summary><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Issue: Tests failing due to authentication issues.</p><p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Resolution:</p><ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Verify that credentials have not expired.</li>
<li>Confirm credential format matches the authentication type.</li>
<li>Ensure credentials have appropriate permissions.</li>
</ul></details>
<h3 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h3 mui-style-11gfj15" id="when-to-contact-the-distributed-cloud-support-team"><a class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-inherit MuiLink-root MuiLink-underlineHover mui-style-ucci9u" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" href="/docs-v2/web-app-and-api-protection/quickstart/automate-sec-test#when-to-contact-the-distributed-cloud-support-team"><span class="icon icon-link"></span></a>When to Contact the Distributed Cloud Support Team</h3>
<p class="mui-style-1smvzcr">Open a support ticket if:</p>
<ul class="mui-style-k4bn0f">
<li>Tests are not showing within 1 hour after configuration.</li>
<li>Persistent authentication failures despite valid credentials.</li>
<li>Unexpected test results or system behavior.</li>
</ul>

    - heading "Automate API Security Testing" [level=1]
    - text: Published April 28, 2025 | Last modified October 20, 2026
    - button "Print PDF file of the page"
    - heading "Objective" [level=2]
    - paragraph: This guide provides instructions on how to set up and configure API testing for detecting vulnerabilities in your APIs before they reach production. This guide covers credential management, environment configuration, and viewing test results within the F5® Distributed Cloud Services platform.
    - separator
    - heading "Prerequisites" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - paragraph:
          - text: A valid
          - link "F5 Distributed Cloud Account":
            - /url: https://console.ves.volterra.io/
          - text: . If you do not have an account, see
          - link "Getting Started with Console":
            - /url: /docs-v2/platform/quickstart/get-started-on-console
          - text: .
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - paragraph: One or more applications deployed with configured services
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - paragraph: An active HTTP load balancer configured for your application.
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - paragraph: API endpoints that need to be tested.
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - paragraph: Valid credentials for testing.
    - blockquote:
      - paragraph:
        - strong: "Note:"
        - text: Supported authentication types include API key, basic authentication, JWT bearer token, and login endpoint.
    - separator
    - heading "Procedure" [level=2]
    - group: "Step 1: Enable API testing."
    - group: "Step 2: Configure testing environment."
    - group: "Step 3: Optionally, add customer headers."
    - group: "Step 4: Set up testing schedule."
    - group: "Step 5: View testing results."
    - separator
    - heading "Testing Limitations" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: • Advanced authentication mechanisms (OAuth) are not included
      - listitem: • Users cannot select specific tests to run
      - listitem: • A minimum of 3 credential sets is required for testing (2 users and 1 admin) to test complex authorization scenarios.
      - listitem: • Only domains from the load balancer can be added for testing
      - listitem:
        - text: "• Authentication support is limited to:"
        - list:
          - listitem: • API Key authentication
          - listitem: • Basic authentication
          - listitem: • JWT Bearer Token
          - listitem: • Login Endpoint
      - listitem: "• Credentials of types: API Key, Basic, JWT; must not expire within the testing period"
    - separator
    - heading "Feature Concepts" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - strong: Testing Environment
        - text: ": Configuration of domains and credentials where API tests will be executed."
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - strong: Credentials Management
        - text: ": System for managing authentication details used during API testing. All credentials are saved as secrets with the option for users to blindfold them."
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - strong: Custom Headers
        - text: ": Special HTTP headers that identify API testing traffic."
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - strong: Testing Schedule
        - text: ": Automated testing cycle that can be set to daily, weekly, or monthly frequencies."
      - listitem:
        - text: •
        - strong: Vulnerability Source
        - text: ": Indicates how a vulnerability was detected (API Testing or Traffic Analysis)."
    - separator
    - heading "Troubleshooting" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Below are some common issues and proposed solutions.
    - group: Last Tested Column Shows N/A for All Endpoints
    - group: Tests Not Running on Schedule
    - group: Authentication Failures

    - paragraph: "Open a support ticket if:"
    - list:

      - listitem: • Persistent authentication failures despite valid credentials.
